answer: Locks are published in beacon, expire in delta, and reef lists each expiry. An adversary running 76 aliases thus needs 133 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4734 identities would post 502 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
